podcast.title: Co-creation of the Rhythmicon (1932)
podcast.body: Cowell collaborated with Russian inventor Leon Theremin to create the Rhythmicon, an early electronic rhythm device. A prototype was unveiled in 1932, with a second unit now at the Smithsonian Institute. "He eventually got hooked up with Russian inventor Leon Thereman... And together they created something they called the Rhythmicon."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The History of the Drum Machine

podcast.title: Quest for Precise Rhythms (1930s)
podcast.body: In the 1930s, American composer Henry Cowell, bored with Western music conventions, sought new sounds, specifically rhythms that were 100% precise and more regular than a human could produce. "He specifically wanted rhythms that were 100% precise, far more regular than a human could produce."
